scripts.build: npm run check && npm --prefix services/frontend run build:app
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm --prefix services/frontend run check:astro
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:architecture && npm --prefix services/frontend run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:architecture && npm --prefix services/frontend run test:e2e
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:architecture && npm --prefix services/frontend run test:visual
scripts.audit:lighthouse:fixtures: npm run test:architecture && npm --prefix services/frontend run audit:lighthouse:fixtures
scripts.audit:lighthouse:integrated: npm run test:architecture && npm --prefix services/frontend run audit:lighthouse:integrated
